description:
About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role{{{{~}}}} 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Communications Intern who is best in class with a high IQ and EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team.

As a Marketing Growth Communications Intern, you will play a critical support role with responsibility for preparing and executing the campaigns behind our consumer programs — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle communications — that reach millions of shoppers. A core focus will be managing our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, RCS/SMS, and in-app messages, building and QAing assets, managing compliance approvals, and reporting on performance. In addition to execution, you will help build content to support channel optimization, segmentation, and analytics across all channels. To achieve these goals, you will engage with varying members across the marketing department, as well as Design, Product and Compliance.

The primary aim for this role is to help create relevant, customized and personalized content for our Sezzle consumers, to maximize revenue and engagement. Beyond executing campaigns, you'll be encouraged to help shape them — proposing the audience, the timing, and the message.

What You'll Do{{{{~}}}}

Build and launch campaigns


Build marketing communications in our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, RCS/SMS, and in-app messages
Build and QA landing pages and campaign assets, making sure everything renders correctly before it reaches a single shopper
Own the day-to-day asset production flow{{{{~}}}} build, quality assurance, approvals, deployment, and communication with internal and external stakeholders
Manage the compliance and legal approval of assets.


Keep the operation running


Support day-to-day operations, keeping every marketing initiative up to date and on schedule
Maintain and organize campaign documentation — briefs, schedules, reports, and final assets
Identify potential risks early and come with a recommendation for how to mitigate them
Support the client and sales teams with in-app promotional setup and reporting


Measure and improve


Pull campaign performance data and report back on what actually happened
Recommend how to optimize the next campaign based on what the last one showed
Test copy, creative, and timing, and help work out which version earns its place
Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to speed up research, first drafts, and reporting


What We Look For{{{{~}}}}

Skills & Competencies


Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English 
Attention to detail is a must. There are plenty of moving parts within this role
Experience copywriting short and engaging messages
Comfortable with numbers — you can look at a table of campaign results and say something useful about it
Basic creative design skills and knowledge of Figma
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, copy, summaries — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related field
Basic project management skills
Prior experience with Braze or another CRM/marketing automation platform is a plus
Experience building email templates or landing pages is a plus
Any experience with email, push notifications, in-app messaging, eCommerce, or digital marketing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You{{{{~}}}}


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome{{{{~}}}}

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

description:
Associate (Intern) - General Merchandise 

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.


Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. 
Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. 
Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. 
Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. 
Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. 
Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 


What will you be doing? 

This internship is designed for students to get hands-on, real-world experience working with a Client Development Team. The internship is for rising year 3 students, interested in pursuing a career in Insights, Analytics, CPG, Retail, Gen Merch or Market Research post-graduation.

Circana offers a full program to ensure ALL our associates gain:


Knowledge about the industry we exist in and the clients we serve. 
Experience working on active projects that have actual impact on our business. 
Training on technical tools and behavioral skills that are critical to an employee’s success. 
Networking and mentor opportunities that can create personal connections. 


Job Responsibilities


Support a team responsible for helping a General Merchandise client (or multiple clients) understand their performance relative to the market and identify opportunities to grow their business and share of the market. 
Understand how to leverage Circana analytics to address clients’ business challenges and market opportunities. 
Translate data into actionable, analytic insights to drive Circana’s clients’ business performance. 
Shadow client meetings to present market research and insights. 
At Circana lateral, promotional, and cross-functional moves are encouraged and part of our culture. While your initial role will be in one of these groups, you’ll have the chance to grow your career both within your initial assignment and into other opportunities that meet your career goals. 


Requirements


Pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree required in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field with a quantitative component, expecting to graduate between June 2027 and December 2027. 
Experience in or knowledge of the Retail or CPG industry preferred (e.g., School projects, case study, or relevant work experience). 
Academic knowledge/coursework in finance, economics, statistics, marketing or marketing analytics, data visualization, and/or logic is preferred. 
Strong intellectual curiosity and critical thinking ability, relentless attention to detail, strong written/verbal communication, ability to work collaboratively on a team, etc. 
Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is a plus but not essential. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, etc.)
Technology aptitude and willingness to learn and work on new solutions and platforms. 
Creative problem-solving skills, ability to frame a business problem, design and execute an analysis plan, and understand and synthesize data findings into business insights and translate into creative data visualizations. 


Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:


Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 


Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid, Mexico City, Mexico

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

description:
Description

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

As an Account Manager Intern you will join one of our business intelligence, retail, or seller services teams. The role provides an opportunity to understand Amazon business and processes, enhance analytical skills, and make significant business impact.

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor. In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. We give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

Interns at Amazon Mexico work 6hs a day (30hs/week) for 12 months. Participants will join Amazon as Interns at our CDMX Mexico Office.

Key job responsibilities


Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered and report on a set of business development targets
Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence
Use feedback to identify opportunities to improve our products, services, processes, systems, and tools
Prospect, qualify, and call important leads
Work with different parts of the Amazon business to implement improvement projects, including working with category teams, product teams, and technical support teams
Support account managers in preparing business reviews and presentations for vendors and sellers on amazon.com.mx


Basic Qualifications


 Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Commerce, Business administration or similar field
 Minimum of 12 months of availability to work as an intern
 Availability to work 30 hours per week


Preferred Qualifications


 Knowledge in MS Office programs as Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint
 Analytical skills
 Planning, prioritization and time-management skills
 Ability to communicate efficiently
 Strong attention to detail
 Experience in financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, marketing, consulting, negotiation or supply chain is a plus
 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML is a plus

skills: Manage the end-to-end logistics of B2B marketing events: trade shows, hosted dinners, executive roundtables, webinars, virtual summits, and partner activations.
Source, negotiate, and manage external vendors (venues, A/V, catering, booth production, swag, event platforms) and own all related contracts and payments.
Build pre-event, during-event, and post-event engagement strategies to maximize pipeline impact from every event dollar spent.
Capture and repurpose event content (recordings, insights, testimonials) into downstream marketing assets.
Own and manage marketing budgets across events and campaigns: forecasting, PO tracking, invoice reconciliation, and ROI reporting.
Manage multiple vendor and agency relationships simultaneously, ensuring deliverables are on time, on budget, and on brand.
Maintain rigorous project management practices across all workstreams — timelines, briefs, status updates, and stakeholder alignment.
Be able to manage workflows, lead scoring, email automation, campaign attribution, list segmentation, and reporting dashboards on HubSpot.
Ensure data hygiene across the CRM: proper UTM tagging, lead source tracking, duplicate management, and lifecycle stage accuracy.
Build and maintain performance dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into marketing's impact on pipeline and revenue.
Analyze campaign and channel performance to deliver actionable insights and recommendations to the team.

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Jasper, Notion AI, etc.) daily across the workflow — content drafting, data analysis, creative production, vendor research, reporting, and process automation.
Identify and implement automation opportunities to eliminate manual, repetitive work across marketing operations.
Stay on top of emerging AI-powered martech tools and proactively bring recommendations to the team.
Be a force multiplier — consistently deliver the output of a much larger team by working smarter with technology.
Collaborate with content and design teams (or lead directly when needed) to produce campaign assets: landing pages, emails, social content, one-pagers, presentations, and sales enablement materials.
Write clear, compelling briefs for creative and content requests, ensuring alignment with campaign goals and brand standards.
Support thought leadership efforts by coordinating webinar content, blog topics, and industry POV pieces with subject-matter experts.
Work closely with Sales to ensure marketing programs/events are aligned with pipeline goals, territory plans, and target account lists.
Partner with Product Marketing to translate product narratives into demand gen campaigns and event messaging.
Provide regular performance updates and strategic recommendations to leadership.
4+ years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally in roles that combined demand gen, events, and marketing ops.
A genuine growth mindset — you're metrics-driven, experiment-happy, and always looking for the next lever to pull.
Solid experience managing events and marketing budgets, vendor contracts, and multi-vendor logistics.
Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot (Marketing Hub & CRM).
Strong analytical skills: you're comfortable in spreadsheets, dashboards, and data. You make decisions with numbers, not gut feeling.
Heavy, daily user of AI tools: you already use AI to write, analyze, automate, and create. This is non-negotiable.
Exceptional organizational skills: you manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders without dropping balls.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Spanish.
Based in Mexico City with availability for occasional travel.
Experience in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS B2B environments.
Familiarity with ABM platforms (Demandbase, 6sense, HubSpot ABM).
Experience with paid media management (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta).
Knowledge of SEO/SEM fundamentals and content marketing strategy.
Experience with analytics and BI tools (Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau).
Experience with event platforms (Whova, Cvent, others).
A high-impact, high-ownership role. You won't be executing someone else's playbook, you'll be building your own.
A team that values speed, resourcefulness, and smart use of technology over headcount.
The chance to shape the marketing function at a growing fintech company where your work directly moves the needle.
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a resourceful, analytical, and execution-obsessed B2B Growth Marketing Specialist to become the operational backbone of our marketing team. This is a hybrid role that spans demand generation, event operations, campaign execution, and marketing ops, all with a relentless focus on pipeline growth and efficiency.

You'll own programs end-to-end: from building the strategy and managing vendor relationships to tracking budgets, analyzing results, and iterating fast. Events are an important part of the mix, but so are ABM plays, content-driven lead gen, partner marketing, and everything in between.

We need someone who doesn't wait for instructions. You see a gap, you fill it. You use AI tools daily to multiply your output. You're as comfortable building a campaign report in HubSpot as you are negotiating a venue contract or writing a landing page brief. If you thrive in fast-paced, "do more with less" environments, this role is for you.




Key Responsibilities

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting, fast-growing business.

The successful candidate will develop and execute lifecycle and outbound strategies (Push, Email, WhatsApp) that move customers through the funnel, from acquisition and first purchase to repeat purchase, Prime adoption and retention. They will act as the bridge between marketing channel owners and category teams, translating category needs into campaigns and programs and bringing company-wide priorities to category teams. They will also own the team's BI and reporting mechanisms, standardizing the metrics category teams use in their weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical and SQL skills, a test-and-learn mindset, and the ability to simplify and scale through automation and AI. They communicate clearly across functions and levels, thrive with ambiguity and changing priorities, and enjoy a highly entrepreneurial environment. Own category outbound marketing (Push, Email, WhatsApp): create campaigns for company priorities and major and seasonal events, ensure campaigns hit goals, and optimize performance across categories.

Own BI and reporting for the Category Marketing team: standardize weekly, monthly and quarterly metrics for category business reviews, with category-level drill-downs and visibility for all teams.

description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Trading is a full-stack team behind the Consumer experience in Kraken mobile and web applications. Our flagship product allows our clients to instantly buy, sell, convert any combination of stocks, cryptocurrencies and cash. We are constantly working on extending the product suite with new features and improvements.

The opportunity


Own the connective tissue between marketing and product at Kraken Consumer — a remit with real scope to shape how millions of people discover and return to our products.
Build something from the ground up: the roadmap, the intake model and the standards for how marketing and product work together are all yours to define.
Sit at the centre of the acquisition funnel, where small improvements in conversion compound into meaningful growth.
Unlock new acquisition channels by building the product surfaces they depend on — paid social, search, affiliates and offline campaigns.
Shape a fast-growing mobile acquisition motion, including in-product social, creator partnerships, community and friend-referral mechanics.
Own both halves of the lifecycle: bringing new users in, and giving existing users compelling reasons to come back.
Work in one of the most competitive corners of consumer fintech, where conversion craft and product quality genuinely decide who wins.


What You Bring


Own the marketing product roadmap end to end, and build the process that turns campaign ideas into shipped product work.
Design and launch tailored campaign experiences — the in-app and web journeys users land in from push, email, social and paid.
Raise the bar on lifecycle messaging so push and email feel useful rather than noisy, and convert accordingly.
Own the incentives layer for new and returning users: offers, referral mechanics, recurring deposits and earn-led campaigns.
Apply user psychology and sharp UX thinking to find where the funnel leaks, then run the experiments that close the gaps.
Improve landing page and search performance, and build the product foundations that make paid and offline channels measurable and worth the spend.
Partner with marketing, design, engineering and data as the single point of ownership for growth enablement.
Define the acquisition and reactivation metrics that matter, and report on them honestly — including when an experiment doesn't land.

title: Marketing Coordinator
skills: Dirigir al equipo de Marketing (analista, diseñador y practicante): distribuir cargas de trabajo, establecer prioridades, dar seguimiento a entregables y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos del área.
Desarrollar al equipo a través de retroalimentación continua, definición de objetivos individuales y participación en el proceso de evaluación de desempeño de la organización.

Definir y ejecutar el plan anual de marketing alineado a las prioridades de la Dirección Comercial, traduciendo los objetivos de venta en campañas por servicio, temporada, vertical o cuenta objetivo (ABM).
Diseñar, ejecutar y optimizar campañas digitales de generación de demanda (mailing, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, SEO y contenido web) con metas explícitas de leads calificados y costo por lead.
Administrar el CRM y las herramientas de automatización de marketing (HubSpot): segmentación, listas, etiquetas, workflows, calificación de leads e integridad de la base de datos.

Construir y mantener el tablero de indicadores del área —leads generados y calificados, costo por lead, tasa de conversión por etapa, oportunidades atribuidas y ROI por campaña y por evento— y presentarlo mensualmente a la Dirección Comercial.
Analizar el desempeño de cada iniciativa y proponer decisiones de reasignación de presupuesto sustentadas en datos, discontinuando las acciones que no generan retorno.

Planear, coordinar y ejecutar la participación de la marca en aproximadamente 18 ferias, expos y eventos de industria al año: presupuesto, proveedores, producción de stand y materiales, logística, comunicación previa, agenda de citas del equipo comercial y seguimiento posterior de contactos en el CRM.

Medir el retorno de cada evento (costo total, contactos capturados, leads calificados y oportunidades generadas) y sustentar con datos la recomendación de mantener, ajustar o retirar cada feria del calendario del siguiente año.
Apoyar directamente al equipo comercial con materiales de venta, presentaciones, casos de éxito, fichas de servicio y campañas de seguimiento que aceleren el ciclo de venta.

Liderar las iniciativas de digitalización del área: automatización de procesos, integración de herramientas y uso de inteligencia artificial para investigación, generación de contenido y eficiencia operativa.
Gestionar el sitio web y la estrategia de contenido (SEO, blogs y artículos técnicos) para incrementar el tráfico orgánico calificado y la visibilidad de la marca.
Gestionar las redes sociales corporativas (LinkedIn, Facebook e Instagram): contenido, calendario, pauta y medición del rendimiento.

Asegurar la consistencia de la marca en todos los puntos de contacto, definiendo y supervisando lineamientos visuales, tono de comunicación, materiales comerciales, eventos y material de comunicación interna en coordinación con Recursos Humanos.
Desarrollar y negociar con proveedores de material publicitario, promocionales y regalos corporativos, asegurando calidad, tiempos de entrega y las mejores condiciones de compra.
Coordinar la logística de envío de materiales y promocionales a las oficinas foráneas, cumpliendo con los tiempos comprometidos por el equipo comercial con el cliente.
Administrar el presupuesto anual de marketing, dar seguimiento al ejercicio del gasto y justificar cada inversión con resultados medibles.
Realizar estudios de benchmark y análisis de la competencia en el mercado de freight forwarding para identificar oportunidades de posicionamiento y diferenciación.
Aprobar los materiales, contenidos y piezas de comunicación generados por el equipo, asegurando la consistencia con la identidad corporativa antes de su publicación o producción.
Alta capacidad de análisis cuantitativo: interpretar datos de campañas y del CRM y convertirlos en decisiones y recomendaciones accionables.
Liderazgo y supervisión de equipos de trabajo: capacidad de distribuir cargas, dar retroalimentación y desarrollar talento junior.
Dominio avanzado de Excel y de herramientas de visualización de datos para construir reportes y tableros de indicadores.
Orientación comercial: comprende el ciclo de venta B2B y opera como socio del equipo de ventas, no como área de soporte.
Mentalidad de retorno de inversión: define métricas antes de ejecutar y sostiene o descarta iniciativas con evidencia.
Dominio de plataformas de CRM y automatización de marketing, preferentemente HubSpot: segmentación, workflows, calificación de leads y reportes de atribución.
Sólidos conocimientos de SEO, SEM, pauta digital (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta) y analítica web (Google Analytics).
Capacidad probada de organización y logística para operar en paralelo un calendario alto de ferias y exposiciones.
Alta capacidad de negociación con proveedores, así como manejo de procesos de pago y facturación.
Sólida capacidad de comunicación escrita y verbal, incluyendo la redacción, edición y presentación de resultados ante dirección.
Autonomía, sentido de urgencia y capacidad de priorizar múltiples proyectos simultáneos con supervisión mínima.
Rápida adaptabilidad a cambios en procesos y prioridades, y capacidad de trabajo bajo presión.
Disponibilidad para viajar y para trabajar horas extendidas o fines de semana durante la operación de eventos.
Conocimientos mínimos deseables en logística internacional para procesos de embarques marítimos, aéreos y terrestres.
Inglés intermedio, capaz de escribir y establecer conversaciones de negocios.
Licenciatura en Marketing, Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Relaciones Comerciales o afín.
De 5 a 7 años de experiencia en marketing B2B con responsabilidad directa sobre generación de demanda y reporte de resultados; deseable en freight forwarding, logística o transporte.
Experiencia comprobable administrando plataformas de CRM y automatización de marketing (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho o similar).
Experiencia comprobable en la coordinación integral de ferias y eventos de industria, incluyendo presupuesto, proveedores y medición de resultados.
Experiencia gestionando presupuesto de marketing y reportando retorno de inversión a nivel dirección.
Experiencia mínima de 2 años liderando equipos de marketing, incluyendo perfiles creativos y analíticos.
Sueldo atractivo de acuerdo con experiencia.
Vales de Despensa.
Fondo de Ahorro 10%.
30 días de aguinaldo.

description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The User & Merchant Growth Senior Analyst role offers a unique opportunity to drive growth in one of the fastest-growing companies, specifically in an exciting & booming new business line. This data-driven position requires a blend of analytical thinking and interpersonal skills to effectively manage the user base and influence behavior.

In this role, you'll be...


Engagement of our merchant partners to our platform as well as the growth of our user & merchant base, via a combination of online and offline strategies, including merchant launch, seasonality and daily promotional & growth strategies;
Building deep data insights and understanding of our potential and existing users and merchants in the local culture, in order to build your own growth-oriented methodologies and initiatives, and also to constantly improve user experience;
Using data to understand user and merchant behavior and experience, and working closely in collaboration with commercial and merchant partners to identify new opporunities for merchant growth, while always being aware and critical of ROI.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


At least 1 year of online Grocery (or Food) delivery business, especially in (user / merchant / category) growth roles is mandatory;
Previous operational/analytical experience in strategy operations, data analytics, consulting, investment banking, or in tech industry, is a plus;
Data driven and strong analytical thinking;
Excellent strategic thinking and evolving mindset;
Self-motivated, self-directed and eager to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

title: Cofundador
description:
Cofundador de Marketing / Socio Estratégico — Leviathan Network




Descripción de la empresa




Leviathan Network es una plataforma tecnológica diseñada para que los fundadores puedan presentar, desarrollar y hacer crecer sus startups y productos, documentando públicamente su evolución y conectándose con las personas, organizaciones e instituciones que pueden ayudarles a avanzar.




Leviathan abarca el ciclo completo de las startups, desde el desarrollo de una idea hasta su crecimiento y consolidación, integrando talento, colaboradores, clientes, usuarios, capital, conocimiento, oportunidades e instituciones.




La plataforma permite desarrollar proyectos, documentar públicamente su evolución y encontrar conexiones y oportunidades para crecer.




Descripción del puesto




Como Cofundador de Marketing / Socio Estratégico de Leviathan Network, la persona seleccionada será responsable de liderar y ejecutar la estrategia de marketing, comunicación, creación de contenido, posicionamiento, adquisición y crecimiento de la plataforma.




El objetivo será posicionar y hacer crecer Leviathan, construir una comunidad activa e incorporar fundadores, startups, productos, profesionales, organizaciones e instituciones.




La posición requiere tanto capacidad estratégica como de ejecución. No se busca únicamente a alguien que diseñe estrategias, administre campañas o supervise a terceros, sino a una persona capaz de involucrarse directamente en la creación de los materiales de marketing que necesita Leviathan.




Esto incluye diseñar piezas gráficas, crear contenido visual y audiovisual, desarrollar publicaciones, producir materiales de comunicación, administrar redes sociales, redactar textos, editar contenido y gestionar su publicación y distribución en distintos canales digitales.




Deberá transformar las funcionalidades, propuestas de valor y avances de Leviathan en contenido atractivo y comprensible que genere interés y nuevos usuarios.




También deberá desarrollar y gestionar la presencia digital de Leviathan, identificar oportunidades de crecimiento orgánico y pagado, implementar estrategias de adquisición, trabajar en SEO, gestionar campañas publicitarias, analizar resultados y optimizar las acciones implementadas.




El puesto integra diseño, creatividad, producción de contenido, comunicación, marketing y adquisición de usuarios en una misma estrategia de crecimiento.




Participará en la definición de la identidad comunicacional y la marca, así como en la manera de presentar Leviathan ante sus diferentes públicos.




Tipo de puesto: Cofundador / Socio Estratégico

Dedicación: Jornada completa (Full-time)

Modalidad de compensación: 5% de equity (participación accionaria en Leviathan Network).




Requisitos




- Experiencia sólida en marketing digital y crecimiento.

- Experiencia en diseño gráfico y creación de materiales visuales para medios digitales.

- Capacidad para desarrollar piezas gráficas, creatividades publicitarias, publicaciones y materiales de comunicación.

- Experiencia en creación, producción y edición de contenido para redes sociales.

- Conocimiento de formatos y estrategias de contenido para Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube y otras redes relevantes.

- Capacidad para desarrollar calendarios editoriales y planificar publicaciones.

- Experiencia administrando redes sociales y gestionando comunidades digitales.

- Capacidad para redactar textos publicitarios, publicaciones, mensajes comerciales y contenido informativo.

- Conocimiento de edición de video y producción audiovisual.

- Experiencia desarrollando estrategias de adquisición y posicionamiento para productos tecnológicos.

- Experiencia en construcción y posicionamiento de marcas.

- Conocimiento de estrategias de crecimiento orgánico y pagado.

- Experiencia con SEO, marketing de contenidos y marketing de performance.

- Capacidad para desarrollar estrategias de adquisición y conversión.

- Conocimiento de analítica y medición de resultados.

- Capacidad para identificar canales de crecimiento.

- Experiencia trabajando con startups, plataformas digitales, SaaS, marketplaces o productos tecnológicos.

- Capacidad para desarrollar estrategias de construcción de comunidad.

- Capacidad para adaptar la comunicación a diferentes perfiles de usuarios y participantes.

- Pensamiento orientado a resultados y crecimiento.

- Autonomía para definir estrategias, crear materiales, ejecutar acciones y medir resultados.

- Capacidad para participar directamente en la definición y evolución de la estrategia de Leviathan.




Se valorará que pueda desarrollar por sí misma el proceso completo de creación de contenido, desde la conceptualización hasta la publicación y análisis.




Perfil que requiere Leviathan




Se busca una persona que combine conocimientos de marketing con capacidades creativas, de diseño, producción de contenido y gestión de redes sociales.




Debe construir la presencia digital de Leviathan: identificar qué comunicar, desarrollar ideas, diseñar piezas, producir contenidos, redactar, editar y gestionar publicaciones.




Deberá convertir las funcionalidades de la plataforma en contenido atractivo y comprensible.




Esto implica saber comunicar el valor de Leviathan mediante distintos formatos, como:




- Diseños gráficos y publicaciones visuales.

- Carruseles informativos.

- Videos cortos y contenido audiovisual.

- Reels y TikToks.

- Videos explicativos y demostraciones de funcionalidades.

- Infografías y materiales promocionales.

- Publicaciones editoriales.

- Campañas publicitarias.

- Contenido educativo e informativo.




El contenido debe responder a objetivos de posicionamiento, reconocimiento de marca, interacción, adquisición y crecimiento de la comunidad, no solo mantener activas las redes.




Deberá lograr que Leviathan sea conocido, entendido, utilizado y recomendado, comprendiendo el recorrido del usuario desde el descubrimiento y registro hasta su participación y permanencia en el ecosistema.




Se valorará combinar diseño, creatividad, comunicación, marketing y análisis, sin depender exclusivamente de terceros para producir contenido.




Se requiere criterio estratégico, creatividad, capacidad técnica, autonomía y orientación a resultados.




Responsabilidades principales




- Diseñar y desarrollar la estrategia de marketing y crecimiento de Leviathan Network.

- Desarrollar el posicionamiento de Leviathan frente a sus diferentes públicos y fortalecer su identidad comunicacional.

- Construir y fortalecer la presencia digital y el reconocimiento de marca.

- Diseñar y producir materiales gráficos para las diferentes plataformas y canales de comunicación.

- Crear contenido visual y audiovisual para redes sociales.

- Desarrollar conceptos creativos para publicaciones, campañas y materiales promocionales.

- Redactar textos, mensajes, publicaciones y contenidos relacionados con la comunicación de Leviathan.

- Editar y producir videos cortos, videos explicativos y otros formatos audiovisuales.

- Diseñar carruseles, infografías, publicaciones y recursos visuales informativos.

- Planificar y gestionar calendarios de contenido.

- Administrar las redes sociales de Leviathan y gestionar su publicación y actividad.

- Desarrollar estrategias de contenido específicas para cada plataforma social.

- Gestionar la distribución del contenido y optimizar su alcance orgánico.

- Incrementar la comunidad y atraer seguidores relevantes.

- Desarrollar estrategias para atraer fundadores y startups.

- Atraer profesionales, talento, organizaciones e instituciones al ecosistema.

- Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias de contenido orientadas a la captación y conversión de usuarios.

- Desarrollar y optimizar estrategias de SEO.

- Diseñar y gestionar campañas de publicidad digital.

- Identificar nuevos canales de adquisición y crecimiento.

- Desarrollar estrategias de conversión y retención.

- Medir el rendimiento del contenido, las redes sociales y las campañas.

- Analizar métricas de alcance, interacción, tráfico, registros, adquisición y conversión.

- Identificar oportunidades de mejora en el recorrido de adquisición y conversión.

- Experimentar, medir y optimizar continuamente las estrategias implementadas.

- Desarrollar materiales y mensajes que expliquen claramente el valor de Leviathan.

- Adaptar las acciones de marketing conforme evolucione la plataforma y aumente el número de fundadores, startups y participantes.




Lo que ofrece Leviathan




- 5% de equity (participación accionaria en Leviathan Network) a cambio de asumir la responsabilidad estratégica y operativa del marketing, diseño, creación y distribución de contenido, gestión de redes sociales y adquisición de usuarios.

- Participación como Cofundador de Marketing / Socio Estratégico.

- Participación directa en las decisiones relacionadas con el posicionamiento, crecimiento, comunicación y estrategia de marketing.

- Un papel estratégico y operativo en la construcción de la marca y expansión de la plataforma.

- La oportunidad de participar en el desarrollo de una plataforma tecnológica enfocada en abarcar el ciclo completo de las startups.




Lo que representa el puesto

Como Cofundador de Marketing / Socio Estratégico, la persona tendrá una participación directa en el crecimiento de Leviathan y una responsabilidad fundamental sobre su posicionamiento, comunicación, creación de contenido, presencia digital, adquisición y expansión.

description:
About McKinney-Vento.org




McKinney-Vento.org (MV Learning, LLC) provides training and software to the people in US school districts responsible for supporting students experiencing homelessness. Under the federal McKinney-Vento Act, every district has a designated liaison for these students, and our platform gives those liaisons the training, tools, and workflows they need to identify students, meet compliance requirements, and get kids the support they are entitled to.




We work with school districts across the country, through direct district partnerships and through state and regional agreements that open our training to every district in the area. We are a small, close-knit team, and the work matters: the faster a district is up and running, the sooner its students get help.




The role




We are hiring a Training Customer Support Specialist to make sure the districts we already work with actually get value from what they have.




Here is the problem you will own. A district signs on, or gains access through a state or regional partnership, and then nothing happens. The liaison is busy, may not realize what they have access to, and often does not respond to email. In our experience, once we reach them by phone, they are glad we called and happy to get started. Your job is to be that call.




You will work from our “at risk” lists: districts that have not yet onboarded, and districts that have onboarded but whose staff are not completing training at the level we would like. You will reach out to them one by one, mostly by phone and also by email and Zoom, walk them step by step through onboarding, answer questions about our products, and help them get their liaisons trained. When something needs fixing or a question is beyond your scope, you coordinate with our Launch team and Account Manager to get it resolved.




This is not a sales role. Every conversation you have is with an existing client. It is about retention, adoption, and making sure the people we serve get what they are already entitled to.




The rhythm of the role follows the school year. Renewals and fiscal-year openings (around July 1) and the start of the school year are busy; other stretches are quieter, and we expect you to use that time with autonomy, improving materials, cleaning up data, and getting ahead on outreach.




What you will do




Outbound outreach to at-risk districts. Work daily through our lists of districts that have not onboarded or are under-using their training, primarily by phone, supported by email and Zoom.
Run onboarding. Schedule and lead onboarding meetings over Zoom, and guide liaisons step by step through registration, account setup, and getting their staff into the training.
Provide training and product support. Answer questions about our products and services, demonstrate features, and help clients get unstuck.
Monitor training success. Pull and send monthly training success reports to the districts we work with, spot districts that are falling behind, and act on red flags early.
Follow up on self-registration. Send reminders and check in with districts that chose to self-register but have not completed the process.
Coordinate internally. Work closely with the Launch team and Account Manager to resolve issues, escalate questions, and keep client records and notes current in our systems.
Improve the process. Keep outreach scripts, email templates, and onboarding guides current, and tell us what is and is not working.
Flex with the seasons. Help where the team needs it most during quieter periods, which may include light outreach support for the account management team.




What we are looking for




Excellent spoken and written English. You will spend most of your day on the phone and in email with US school district staff, and you need to be clear, warm, and professional in both.
Comfortable on the phone. You are happy to pick up the phone and call someone who has not replied to three emails, and you can turn a cold reception into a productive conversation.
Patient, friendly, and persistent. Our clients are busy educators. You can explain the same thing many times without losing your enthusiasm, and you do not give up after one unanswered call.
Organized and self-directed. You can manage a long list of districts, keep accurate notes, follow up on time, and stay productive without someone looking over your shoulder.
Comfortable with software. You can learn a web platform well enough to teach it, and you are at ease with Zoom, email and Google docs.
A problem-solver. When a client hits a wall, you figure out whether you can solve it, and if not, who can, and you follow it through to resolution.
Reliable availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern.

Bonus points

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

In this role, you’d be joining the Professional Services team. Our team’s mission is to empower every Stripe user to achieve maximum value from their investment quickly and confidently. Our team helps Stripe increase the GDP of the internet by supporting the success of our large, intricate Stripe implementations. This involves guiding users through their integration process, project planning, coordinating with stakeholders, handling deliverables, meeting key timelines, and educating our users about the maximum potential they can achieve with Stripe.

As an Implementation Consultant at Stripe, you are the driving force behind these strategic implementations. Your role is key in leading them through the integration process, turning them into long-term transacting Stripe users. Our team’s core objective is to provide an efficient, seamless transition for our clients, assuring top-notch user satisfaction and relationship management.

What you’ll do

As an Implementation Consultant, you will be managing the full onboarding cycle for mid-market and enterprise companies from contract signing through launch. You will proactively develop and manage integration architecture, change management strategy, and timelines. You will be expected to collaborate across departments, including Sales, Technical Services, Product, and Engineering, to ensure a successful transition for our clients.

Responsibilities


Own the full onboarding cycle for mid-market and enterprise companies from contract signing through launch.
Develop, manage, and implement a customer’s integration architecture, change management strategy, and timeline.
Partner with other Sales and Technical Services teams to improve the overall Stripe user journey.
Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help drive product strategy for large users.
Collaborate with teammates on strategic projects that improve and scale our implementation process and team operations.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


4+ years of experience working with strategic customers on technology solutions, with a track record of top performance
Ability to understand complex business requirements and craft tailored solutions
Quick learner with the ability to explain technical concepts to Stripe’s largest customers
Proven project management skills and strong critical thinking abilities
Experience identifying and solving internal process inefficiencies
Superior verbal and written communication skills
Ability to operate independently in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company
Experience in the payments industry
Knowledge of APIs
Knowledge of SQL



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

You will facilitate the crucial transition from intensive technical configuration into long-term product utilization, empowering clients to become entirely self-sufficient before successfully handing them off to long-term relationship managers.

Maintain Flawless Context:

description:
Job Description

The Global Account Director is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading, protecting, and growing strategic global client relationships. This role owns the overall account strategy, combining executive-level relationship management, commercial ownership, operational judgment, and the ability to lead complex global teams through influence.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience owning $50M+ USD client relationships, with accountability for revenue retention, profitability, and year-over-year growth of 4% or greater. This role requires strong C-suite relationship management and the ability to mobilize cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams to solve complex customer challenges and drive profitable growth.

Experience in financial services, banking, payments, or enterprise technology is strongly preferred, with knowledge of ATM/self-service banking, software, services, and managed solutions highly valued.

Responsibilities


Strategic Account Leadership


 Own the global strategy and overall business relationship for assigned strategic accounts. 
 Build and execute disciplined, multi-year account plans incorporating stakeholder maps, installed base, renewal exposure, service performance and risks, competitive position, whitespace opportunities, and clearly defined growth priorities. 
 Develop an extensive understanding of the client's business strategy, operating model, technology environment, competitive landscape, and investment priorities. 
 Translate customer priorities into actionable account strategies that protect the existing business while creating sustainable opportunities for expansion. 
 Lead internal and external global account governance, aligning local, regional, and global stakeholders around shared priorities. 



Revenue Growth & Commercial Ownership


 Own and oversee a strategic account portfolio of $50M+ USD in annual revenue, with accountability for revenue retention, profitable growth, and overall commercial performance. 
 Drive year-over-year account growth objectives of approximately 4% or greater, developing clear strategies to achieve growth targets. 
 Identify expansion opportunities across hardware, software, services, managed services, modernization, fleet transformation, payments, and adjacent solutions. 
 Shape complex proposals, pricing strategies, service packages, contract changes, and business cases with strong commercial and margin discipline. 
 Balance growth ambition with sound judgment around profitability, delivery capability, commercial exposure, and customer risk. 
 Know when to defend value, when to negotiate, and when potential revenue carries unacceptable commercial or delivery risk. 



Executive Relationship Management


 Establish trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior decision-makers across business, technology, operations, procurement, security, and other critical functions. 
 Act as a strategic advisor by understanding the customer's business objectives, challenges, competitive pressures, and transformation agenda. 
 Lead executive business reviews that are candid, forward-looking, data driven, and focused on actions and outcomes. 
 Navigate complex stakeholder environments and build alignment across multiple decision-makers and buying centers. 
 Represent the customer internally while balancing customer priorities with the organization's commercial and operational objectives. 



Global & Cross-Functional Orchestration


 Mobilize Sales, Service, Operations, Product, Implementation, Finance, Legal, Technology, and senior leadership around the customer's strategy and priorities. 
 Lead through influence across functions, countries, and organizational boundaries without relying on direct reporting authority. 
 Ensure the customer experiences one coordinated global team, even when delivery involves multiple business units, functions, or geographies. 
 Influence internal decisions related to product strategy, service delivery, solution development, investment priorities, and customer commitments. 



Delivery Ownership & Operational Resilience


 Maintain executive-level visibility into service performance, SLAs, implementation dependencies, operational challenges, and customer-impacting risks. 
 Partner closely with service and delivery leadership to ensure commitments are understood and customer outcomes are achieved. 
 Take ownership when problems arise, bringing together the right stakeholders to establish accountability and drive resolution. 
 Anticipate and escalate risks before local operational issues develop into broader commercial or executive relationship concerns. 
 Maintain a strong connection between what is sold, what is contractually committed, and what can successfully be delivered. 



Negotiation & Stakeholder Navigation


 Lead and influence complex negotiations involving pricing, contracts, renewals, service levels, commercial terms, and expansion opportunities. 
 Navigate long decision cycles, multiple buying centers, procurement pressure, and politically complex customer organizations. 
 Effectively balance local and global customer priorities. 
 Build consensus and influence decisions internally and externally without relying on formal authority. 



Data-Led Account Management


 Use CRM, financial, operational, and commercial data to maintain a comprehensive understanding of account performance and health. 
 Maintain visibility into revenue, margin, pipeline, forecast confidence, renewals, service KPIs, churn risk, customer health, and expansion opportunities. 
 Maintain disciplined CRM and forecasting practices. 
 Use data and insights to proactively address risk, prioritize investment, and identify opportunities. 



Qualifications


Required Qualifications


 Degree, diploma, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. 
 8–10+ years of progressive experience in global, strategic, enterprise, or complex account leadership, with demonstrated success in commercially accountable or quota-carrying roles.

description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a customer-focused and detail-oriented individual to be a founding Service Delivery Manager on our Customer Data Services team. You’ll own the delivery of our Data Ingestion service packages end‑to‑end—from scoping the customer’s data landscape to aligning timelines and managing service hours—ensuring a predictable, on‑time, on‑budget experience that accelerates customer time-to-value. You’ll work closely with our customers, external partners, and with internal stakeholders such as Data Specialists, Customer Success Managers, and Sustainability Data Advisors to ensure the successful delivery of our services.

You will:


Own end‑to‑end delivery of Data Ingestion service packages: Run kickoff, define scope and success criteria, build project plans, manage execution through completion, and hand off cleanly to post-go live teams
Scope packages and solutions: Lead discovery to understand the customer’s data sources, formats, owners, and quality constraints, and coordinate with partners on potential solutions. 
Align on timelines and hold accountability: Set clear, reasonable timelines with customers and in collaboration with partners; sequence dependencies across internal and customer teams. Hold internal collaborators and customers accountable to milestones; renegotiate timelines transparently when inputs change. 
Control service hours and budget: Track work against quoted hours; forecast burn and course‑correct early to stay within budget. Identify out‑of‑scope requests; manage change to protect margin and customer trust. 
Identify risks and escalations: Proactively surface risks (e.g., missing data owners, low data quality, timeline slippage); drive mitigation plans and timely escalations. 


You might be a fit if you:


Have 3-6 years of experience delivering client services in B2B software or consulting
Have directly owned client relationships and are energized by solving client problems
Are customer obsessed and operate with high ownership; you anticipate needs and remove blockers without being asked. 
Are detail-oriented with strong organization skills; you keep scope, timelines, and artifacts tight and current. 
Identify risks proactively and solve problems in a structured manner; you raise issues early with options and tradeoffs. 
Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are motivated, systematic, and efficient. You thrive in a high-volume environment. 


Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

description:
About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate, Banking & Lending to bring go-to-market plans to life across Sezzle’s growing set of financial products, both live and upcoming. The Head of Product Marketing owns strategy and go-to-market for these products. You’ll own execution{{{{~}}}} turning those plans into shipped tests, campaigns, and lifecycle messaging, and reporting back what the data says.

This role is well-suited for someone who loves getting things built and out the door, is energized by data, and wants to learn how product marketing strategy is made by working right next to it. Priorities follow company goals and key performance metrics, so you’ll spend more time on some products than others as launches and opportunities shift.

The salary range for this role is $2,500 - $3,333 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Testing & Optimization


Turn insights about where users drop off in product journeys into experiments that improve the experience
Build and run tests in whatever form they take, from in-app copy and design changes to targeted email and push campaigns, working with product managers and designers
Share results clearly and quickly, and flag anything that suggests we should change course
Treat everything as a test{{{{~}}}} design for learning, monitor results, and iterate based on what the data tells you


Research & Insights


Run user research end to end once the questions are set{{{{~}}}} build the survey or study, send it to the right group of users, analyze the results, and write them up
Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities
Use AI tools to speed up analysis and sharpen the insights you bring back


Go-to-Market Execution


Turn launch and marketing plans into clear project timelines with owners and dates
Partner with our marketing communications team to bring email, push, and in-app campaigns to life
Guide marketing materials through compliance and legal review in a regulated industry
Coordinate everything needed to get new products ready for launch


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation


Work closely with product managers, marketing communications, design, compliance, and data teams on every product you touch
Share regular progress updates with the team and cross-functional partners
Document research findings and test results, and keep team strategy documents up to date
Adapt quickly as priorities and launch timing shift


Qualifications

Required


2+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Lifecycle Marketing, Consumer Research, or a related field
Strong analytical skills{{{{~}}}} comfortable working with funnel data, behavioral data, and survey results, and using AI to evaluate them
Highly organized and execution-minded, with a track record of getting work shipped on time across multiple stakeholders
Clear, concise written communicator in English, able to turn complex results into a sharp readout
Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you’re already using them regularly


Nice to Have


Experience in fintech, banking, lending, payments, or credit products
Experience getting marketing copy through compliance or legal review in a regulated industry
Experience running A/B tests or in-product experiments
Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
Familiarity with user research methodologies


About You{{{{~}}}}


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
