description:
Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Commerce Media Specialist, you will support the execution and optimization of marketing campaigns within the commerce media ecosystem. Serás quien identifique nuevas oportunidades de colaboración en plataformas digitales, contacte potenciales socios y construya relaciones comerciales de largo plazo.

Queremos conocer personas con un perfil comercial, gusto por las redes sociales y facilidad para construir relaciones.

✔ Entre 1 y 2 años de experiencia en ventas, atención al cliente, prospección digital, influencer marketing, account management o desarrollo de negocios.

✔ Experiencia o interés en contactar clientes, afiliados o creadores de contenido mediante redes sociales y plataformas digitales.

✔ Excelente comunicación escrita y habilidad para negociar de manera natural.

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Specialist, you will execute and optimize Paid Search and Shopping campaigns to drive efficient client growth. You’ll build high‑quality account structures, translate performance data into clear next actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights under guidance to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, partner across your Pod (Channel SMEs, Analytics, Creative, Client Leads, Product/Bliss Point), and continuously document and improve your workflows. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.
Prepare clear, on‑time performance updates and inputs for QBRs with actionable next steps.


Product‑Led


Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate sound channel craft and growing cross‑channel awareness; connect measurement to growth; follow and help refine team playbooks and SOPs.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.


KPIs


Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.


We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a hybrid work environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 16 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

title: Senior Video Creative, Performance - Kraken Consumer
skills: Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.


Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.
Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.
Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.
Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.
Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

title: Product Manager Kinder
skills: Desarrollarás la visión y estrategia de la marca a corto, mediano y largo plazo, identificando oportunidades relevantes dentro de la categoría y el portafolio que permitan maximizar el crecimiento rentable del negocio.

Definirás y evolucionarás el posicionamiento de la marca, liderando el desarrollo y la ejecución de campañas de comunicación que conecten con los consumidores y fortalezcan su presencia en el mercado.
Coordinarás e implementarás los planes de marketing y las acciones de la marca, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, P&L y participación de mercado.
Gestionarás el presupuesto de la marca, definiendo la asignación de recursos y dando seguimiento a inversiones y gastos para maximizar la eficiencia del A&P y su impacto en el negocio.

Analizarás continuamente las tendencias del mercado, la competencia, los consumidores y los canales de venta, identificando insights, oportunidades de crecimiento y ventajas competitivas que fortalezcan la estrategia de la marca.
Monitorearás el desempeño de ventas y P&L de la marca, evaluando los resultados frente al plan operativo e impulsando acciones correctivas con los equipos involucrados cuando sea necesario.

Liderarás la estrategia y evolución del portafolio para incrementar la penetración y frecuencia de consumo, desarrollar nuevas ocasiones de consumo y alcanzar nuevos segmentos, asegurando la rentabilidad de la marca.

Supervisarás el desarrollo de iniciativas de innovación y extensiones de producto, asegurando que generen valor incremental para el negocio y minimizando posibles efectos de canibalización sobre el portafolio core.

Coordinarás el desarrollo y la implementación de estrategias de comunicación y medios, trabajando con equipos internos y agencias para asegurar la correcta ejecución del posicionamiento de la marca y la mejora continua de las inversiones.
Trabajarás de manera cercana con los equipos globales, alineando estrategias, posicionamiento, prioridades, innovación y planes de comunicación con los lineamientos de la marca.

Colaborarás transversalmente con equipos comerciales y áreas especializadas, incluyendo Trade Marketing, Food Service, Consumer Market Insights, S&OP, Finanzas, Media & Digital, Legal, Relaciones Públicas, Logística y Calidad, para garantizar una ejecución integral de la estrategia.

Promoverás una cultura orientada al consumidor y al uso de Market Research, asegurando que los insights y aprendizajes obtenidos permitan anticipar tendencias, detectar nuevas necesidades y fortalecer la toma de decisiones.
Desarrollarás las capacidades y habilidades del equipo a tu cargo, brindando dirección, retroalimentación y retos que favorezcan su crecimiento y contribución a los objetivos del negocio.
Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Administración de Empresas, Negocios, Comunicación o carrera afín.
Experiencia sólida en Brand Management y Marketing, incluyendo estrategia de marca, posicionamiento, comunicación, innovación y gestión de portafolio.
Experiencia en administración de P&L, presupuestos de marketing y A&P, así como en análisis de ventas y desempeño de marca.
Conocimiento de consumer insights, market research, análisis de mercado y comportamiento del consumidor, así como desarrollo y ejecución de campañas de comunicación y estrategias de medios.
Experiencia liderando y desarrollando equipos, promoviendo la colaboración, el accountability y la orientación a resultados.
Competencias: mentalidad estratégica, integración organizacional y manejo de personas.
Inglés avanzado o conversacional, debido a la interacción frecuente con equipos globales.

description:
Company Description

Susurros del Corazón, Auberge Collection, is a vibrant oceanfront enclave set between jungled cliffs and a pristine stretch of shoreline overlooking Bahía de Banderas in Punta de Mita on Mexico’s Pacific Coast. The resort offers 82 ocean-view studios, casitas, and suites, along with 30 two- to five-bedroom casas and oceanfront residences, highlighted by a seven-bedroom signature villa. The resort is home to several dining venues, including Casamilpa, a signature restaurant featuring Mediterranean cuisine with Mexican influences, La Boquita, an open-air taqueria, as well as a pool bar, private cabanas, and captivating epicurean experiences exploring global flavors. ONDA, Wellbeing by Auberge, is a sanctuary where joy fuels wellness, inviting a holistic experience that beckons the rhythmic energy of the waves. Three infinity-edge pools cascading down to the beach and Morritos Kids Club create a haven for relaxation and family memories. An array of unscripted adventures and experiences invite exploration, celebrating Mexico’s rich culture and embodying the playful spirit of a luxuriously relaxed surf retreat in an unspoiled oceanside oasis.

For more information: auberge.com/susurros.

Connect with Susurros del Corazón, Auberge Collection on Instagram @SusurrosAuberge and #AlwaysAuberge.

Job Description

Join our team as Experience Manager and become one of the authors of our story. The Experience Manager at Susurros del Corazon will embark on a brand-defining program of deepening our “soulful” experiences at our property. This role will spearhead this effort for Susurros del Corazon, and as such, will be responsible for initiating, facilitating, and guiding well-designed and creatively curated guest and team experiences unique to our properties through adventures, activities, classes, amenities, product selection, partner alignment, and space activation. This role is integral to establishing and maintaining thematic stories and elements that influence and guide the resorts’ guest experience. title: Growth Operator
description:
Growth Operator | Founding Team




ANEKO AI | Mexico City | Full-time




Want to start your own company someday? Come build with us first.




We’re looking for someone who wants a lot more than another job.




Someone who’s already built outbound systems, knows how to sell, is knee-deep in AI, and wants to learn everything else that goes into building a startup.




You’ll work directly with Aneko’s Founder & CEO and join the early team of a Techstars-backed healthcare AI company with global ambitions.




Your first focus will be growth. Where you go from there depends on what you make happen.




A little about ANEKO




Aneko was born from a personal experience with a delayed cancer diagnosis. Our mission is simple: No diagnosis should be made on missing information.




We’re starting by transforming medical imaging with AI, with a bigger vision of intelligent digital twins for clinicians that can move with them across healthcare systems.




We’re building technology with the potential to change how healthcare works and improve millions of lives.




What you’ll do




Your first challenge is helping build our growth engine.




* Build AI-powered outbound systems that generate qualified opportunities.

* Find creative ways to reach healthcare executives.

* Experiment with AI agents, Clay, automations, and whatever else gets results.

* Help develop marketing, messaging, content, and campaigns.

* Get involved in customer conversations and help move deals forward.




But you won’t be limited to growth. You’ll work across fundraising, partnerships, investor meetings, new markets, hiring, and whatever else the company needs.




You’ll wear multiple hats, get your hands dirty, and have a real say in how we grow.




What makes this opportunity different?




You’ll work alongside an experienced founder who’s spent years building and scaling technology companies.




You’ll meet investors, founders, and industry leaders. Travel to startup events and business meetings. Get firsthand exposure to fundraising, sales, marketing, product, and the decisions that shape a company.




You’ll have room to experiment, challenge ideas, take ownership, and learn from mistakes.




As ANEKO grows, we want you to grow with it. More responsibility, more ownership, and opportunities to lead.




The goal is to give future founders the kind of experience that would otherwise take years to gain.




Who we’re looking for




You’ve built outbound systems and have hands-on experience selling.




You’re constantly experimenting with AI tools, agents, and automation.




You’re creative, resourceful, curious, and know how to figure things out.




You can think big while paying attention to details and following through.




You’re fluent in English. Native-level fluency is a big plus.




You have real entrepreneurial ambition and want to challenge yourself the build big! 




Location and travel requirements:




Must currently reside in Mexico City. This position is exclusively for candidates based in CDMX.




Must hold a current, valid U.S. visa and be available for international business travel.




Must be willing to travel internationally for meetings, conferences, and startup events.




What you’ve accomplished, how you think, and what drives you matter far more than your degree or job titles.




If you’re looking for a predictable 9-to-5, this isn’t it. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys doing whatever it takes to win, and the constant learning that come with building a startup.




How to apply




Skip the generic cover letter. We want to get to know you.




Along with your CV or LinkedIn profile, answer two questions:




1. Tell us about something you’ve built or made happen that you’re genuinely proud of. What was it, what did you do, and what happened?




2. Tell us something interesting about yourself that has absolutely nothing to do with work. An unusual passion, an experience, an obsession, anything that tells us something about you.




Please no AI slop. We want to hear your voice, not ChatGPT’s idea of what an impressive candidate sounds like. Use AI all you want, but bring your own thinking.




If your ambition is to build a startup someday, come build with us first.

About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a data-driven, highly organized Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist to join our Marketplace team and report to the Product Manager for Marketplace. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

The Marketplace is where shoppers discover stores, products, and deals inside the Sezzle app. Our team runs a lot of features, and there's almost always something being tested. You'll be the person who knows what's live, who it's live for, and how it's performing.

This is an operations role with a strong product and data lens. You'll launch and track A/B tests, keep an eye on our shopping partners, and turn results into clear recommendations on what we do next. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, design, and partnerships. If you like running a lot of experiments at once and keeping every one of them organized, this role is for you.

The salary range for this role is $2,000 - $2,666 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Experimentation


Set up, QA, and launch A/B tests across Marketplace features. Make sure targeting, variants, and tracking are right before anything goes live.
Monitor running tests, flag issues early, and call results once they reach significance.
Keep a single source of truth for every test{{{{~}}}} what's live, who sees it, and what we learned.


Partner & Marketplace Operations


Create and manage placements, promotions, coupons, and offers across the Sezzle app.
Set up and manage cashback programs in our internal admin tools.
Onboard new online stores into the marketplace and activate their store domains, so more stores are shoppable in the app.
Keep a clear map of which user and merchant segments see which features, placements, and offers.
Run regular QA audits, work through user-reported issues and broken links, and set up alerts so problems get caught before users notice.


Reporting & Process


Benchmark our shopping experience against competitors and bring new ideas for placements, deals, and offers that get more users shopping.
Document test plans, results, and processes, and find parts of the workflow that can be automated with AI.


What We Look For

Required


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
1 to 3+ years of experience in operations, experimentation, or product analytics.
Highly organized. You can run many tests and workstreams at once without anything slipping.
Clear written and verbal communication in English, with teammates across the business and external partners.
Strong analytical skills. Comfortable with SQL and dashboards, and able to read A/B test results (lift, significance, sample size).
Comfortable in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift.
Detail-oriented with a QA mindset. You catch the targeting mistake before it launches. 
Daily user of Claude or a similar AI tool. You use it to analyze data, write queries, draft docs, and automate repetitive work, and you can walk us through real examples.


Nice to Have


Experience with A/B testing or feature flag tools, such as Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or Firebase.
Experience with affiliate, cashback, or advertising partnerships.
Experience with Jira and Confluence.
Experience with mobile apps and product analytics tools, such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.


About You{{{{~}}}}


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome{{{{~}}}}

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

description:
ACERCA DE CHILDREN INTERNATIONAL




Children International agencia Jalisco es una asociación afiliada de Children International, una organización global sin fines de lucro con oficinas centrales en Kansas City, Estados Unidos.

Children International (CI) implementa programas de desarrollo de la niñez y juventud en todo el mundo, con el objetivo de romper el ciclo de la pobreza generacional. Con un enfoque personalizado y de largo plazo, acompañamos a niñas, niños y jóvenes en 10 países durante las dos primeras décadas de sus vidas. Al brindarles acceso a educación, atención médica y referentes positivos, junto con habilidades para la vida y competencias laborales, les ayudamos a convertirse en adultos empoderados, con empleos sostenibles y capaces de mejorar sus vidas, las de sus familias y sus comunidades. Nuestro compromiso es permanente, porque sabemos que los casi 220,000 niños, niñas y jóvenes a quienes apoyamos merecen una verdadera oportunidad.

title: Latin America Communications Strategist/Estratega de Comunicaciones para América Latina
skills: Work with partner organizations to strengthen their communications strategies for public interest legal and advocacy efforts in Mexico and other Latin American countries;
Coordinate with the Earthjustice communications team when joint or complementary public messaging is appropriate;

Identify opportunities for partner organizations to use traditional media, digital communications, social media, opinion writing, and other public-facing strategies to increase the impact of partner-led legal and advocacy work;
Develop audience-informed messaging and narrative frames that make complex legal, scientific, and technical issues accessible to decision-makers and the broader public;
Draft, edit, or advise on press releases, op-eds, web content, social media content, and other communications materials;
Build and maintain relationships with journalists, digital media influencers, and other media contacts in Mexico and, as relevant, other Latin American media markets;
Monitor relevant media coverage, public narratives, and communications trends in Mexico and Latin America, and provide periodic recommendations to improve messaging;
Participate in virtual meetings with International Program staff and communicating frequently to keep the International Program informed about the progress of the work; and

Attend in-person meetings with partners in Mexico and travelling several times a year to the United States and other countries to meet with Earthjustice and our other international partners (costs associated with required business travel will be reimbursed.).
Work will be conducted in both Spanish and English.

At least 5 years of experience in communications, media strategy, journalism, public relations, digital advocacy, or a related field, with substantial experience in Mexico or another Latin American media market.
Proven experience developing and implementing communications strategies for nonprofit, public interest, journalism, environmental, human rights, or social justice work.
Demonstrated ability to pitch stories, prepare spokespeople, and secure media coverage in Mexico or another Latin American media market.

Strong understanding of the media landscape in Mexico, including experience working with journalists and digital media influencers; (existing relationships with journalists or communications professionals in Mexico or other Latin American media markets a plus).
Excellent written and oral communication skills in Spanish and English.

Ability to translate complex scientific and legal issues into compelling, accessible communications; (familiarity with environmental protection, fossil fuels, energy planning, clean air, climate, human rights, or the right to a healthy environment a plus).
Sound judgment in politically sensitive or high-stakes advocacy contexts, including the ability to coordinate communications with special sensitivity to the perspectives of affected communities.
Ability to prioritize, manage multiple deadlines, and respond quickly to new opportunities and developments.

description:
Earthjustice is the United States' leading environmental law organization. We wield the power of law and the strength of partnership to protect people’s health, preserve magnificent places and wildlife, advance clean energy, and combat climate change. We are here because the Earth needs a good lawyer.

Earthjustice's International Program works across borders to protect the global environment. Drawing on deep experience in human rights law, environmental law, and energy law and policy, we work with partners around the world using strategic legal advocacy to reduce dependence on dirty fossil fuels, accelerate deployment of clean energy, protect biodiversity, and defend human rights.

Earthjustice’s International Program seeks a Mexico-based Communications Strategist to strengthen the impact of our work with partner organizations in Latin America. The International Program works in partnership with public interest legal organizations in Mexico and elsewhere in Latin America to establish, strengthen, and enforce national and international legal protections for the environment and communities.

The Communications Strategist will develop and advise on communications strategies for legal and advocacy efforts to protect the human right to a healthy environment and promote a just energy transition. The work will focus on Mexico, and additional work related to Argentina, Colombia, and Chile and other regional priorities as needed.

The goal of this work is to help partner organizations raise the profile of public interest legal work, reach priority audiences, and increase the impact of cases and campaigns. In this role, the Communications Strategist will work with Earthjustice staff and partner organizations to translate complex legal, scientific, and technical issues into clear, compelling, and accurate public communications. The Strategist will help identify media opportunities, develop strategic messaging, strengthen partner communications, and support public narratives that advance environmental protection, clean air, a just energy transition, and the human right to a healthy environment.

The Communications Strategist will work as part of a team based in Mexico City and will collaborate closely with Earthjustice International Program staff at all stages of the work.

The successful candidate will be engaged as an employee of an Employer of Record (EOR) rather than employed by Earthjustice directly.

Responsibilities


Work with partner organizations to strengthen their communications strategies for public interest legal and advocacy efforts in Mexico and other Latin American countries;
Coordinate with the Earthjustice communications team when joint or complementary public messaging is appropriate;
Identify opportunities for partner organizations to use traditional media, digital communications, social media, opinion writing, and other public-facing strategies to increase the impact of partner-led legal and advocacy work;
Develop audience-informed messaging and narrative frames that make complex legal, scientific, and technical issues accessible to decision-makers and the broader public;
Draft, edit, or advise on press releases, op-eds, web content, social media content, and other communications materials; 
Build and maintain relationships with journalists, digital media influencers, and other media contacts in Mexico and, as relevant, other Latin American media markets;
Monitor relevant media coverage, public narratives, and communications trends in Mexico and Latin America, and provide periodic recommendations to improve messaging;
Participate in virtual meetings with International Program staff and communicating frequently to keep the International Program informed about the progress of the work; and
Attend in-person meetings with partners in Mexico and travelling several times a year to the United States and other countries to meet with Earthjustice and our other international partners (costs associated with required business travel will be reimbursed.).
Work will be conducted in both Spanish and English.


Qualifications:


At least 5 years of experience in communications, media strategy, journalism, public relations, digital advocacy, or a related field, with substantial experience in Mexico or another Latin American media market.
Proven experience developing and implementing communications strategies for nonprofit, public interest, journalism, environmental, human rights, or social justice work.
Demonstrated ability to pitch stories, prepare spokespeople, and secure media coverage in Mexico or another Latin American media market.
Strong understanding of the media landscape in Mexico, including experience working with journalists and digital media influencers; (existing relationships with journalists or communications professionals in Mexico or other Latin American media markets a plus).
Excellent written and oral communication skills in Spanish and English.
Ability to translate complex scientific and legal issues into compelling, accessible communications; (familiarity with environmental protection, fossil fuels, energy planning, clean air, climate, human rights, or the right to a healthy environment a plus).
Sound judgment in politically sensitive or high-stakes advocacy contexts, including the ability to coordinate communications with special sensitivity to the perspectives of affected communities.
Ability to prioritize, manage multiple deadlines, and respond quickly to new opportunities and developments.


Salary and Benefits:

The salary range for this position is MXN 878,000 – 960,000 (approximately USD 45,500 – 56,000).

Salary is based on experience.

ENGAGEMENT STATEMENT: The successful candidate will be engaged as an employee of an Employer of Record (EOR) rather than employed by Earthjustice directly. Benefits will be provided through the EOR and may differ from those offered to Earthjustice employees.

Applications submitted by Monday, November 30 will be given priority, and applications received after the priority deadline may be reviewed on a rolling basis until the role is filled. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Please note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work to be performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

Estratega de Comunicaciones para América Latina

Earthjustice es la principal organización de derecho ambiental sin ánimo de lucro de interés público especializada en derecho ambiental en Estados Unidos. Utilizamos la fuerza de la ley y el trabajo conjunto con organizaciones aliadas para proteger la salud de las personas, preservar lugares de gran valor natural y la vida silvestre, además de promover la energía limpia y combatir el cambio climático. Estamos aquí porque la tierra necesita justicia.

El Programa Internacional de Earthjustice trabaja cruzando fronteras para proteger el medio ambiente a nivel mundial. Con base en nuestra amplia experiencia en la defensa de los derechos humanos, derecho ambiental y derecho y política energética, colaboramos con organizaciones aliadas de todo el mundo mediante estrategias de defensa jurídica para reducir la dependencia de los combustibles fósiles contaminantes, acelerar la transición hacia las energías limpias, proteger la biodiversidad y proteger los derechos humanos.

El Programa Internacional de Earthjustice busca incorporar a un/a estratega de comunicaciones con sede en México para fortalecer el impacto de nuestro trabajo con organizaciones aliadas en América Latina. El Programa Internacional colabora con organizaciones jurídicas de interés público en México y en el resto de América Latina para desarrollar, fortalecer y hacer cumplir las protecciones jurídicas nacionales e internacionales para el medio ambiente y las comunidades.

La persona seleccionada desarrollará estrategias de comunicación y brindará asesoría en esta materia para apoyar acciones de defensa jurídica e incidencia destinadas a proteger el derecho humano a un medio ambiente sano y promover una transición energética justa. El trabajo se enfocará principalmente en México e incluirá proyectos relacionados con Argentina, Colombia y Chile, así como con otras prioridades regionales según sea necesario.

El objetivo de este trabajo es ayudar a las organizaciones aliadas a dar mayor visibilidad a la práctica jurídica de interés público, llegar a las audiencias prioritarias y aumentar el impacto de los casos y las campañas. En este puesto, la persona seleccionada trabajará con el personal de Earthjustice y de las organizaciones aliadas para convertir cuestiones jurídicas, científicas y técnicas complejas en comunicaciones públicas claras, convincentes y rigurosas. La persona ayudará a identificar oportunidades en los medios de comunicación, desarrollar mensajes estratégicos, fortalecer las capacidades de comunicación de las organizaciones aliadas y promover narrativas públicas que promuevan la protección ambiental, el aire limpio, una transición energética justa y el derecho humano a un medio ambiente sano.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo con sede en la Ciudad de México y colaborará estrechamente con el personal del Programa Internacional de Earthjustice en todas las etapas del trabajo.

La persona seleccionada será contratada como empleada por medio de un Employer of Record (EOR), y no directamente por Earthjustice.

Responsabilidades


Trabajar con organizaciones aliadas para fortalecer sus estrategias de comunicación relacionadas con acciones de defensa jurídica e incidencia en México y otros países de América Latina;
Coordinarse con el equipo de Comunicaciones de Earthjustice cuando sea apropiado difundir mensajes públicos conjuntos o complementarios;
Identificar oportunidades para que las organizaciones aliadas utilicen medios tradicionales, plataformas digitales, redes sociales, artículos de opinión y otras estrategias de comunicación pública con el fin de aumentar el impacto de las acciones jurídicas y la incidencia lideradas por ellas;
Desarrollar mensajes y marcos narrativos que traduzcan cuestiones jurídicas, científicas y técnicas complejas a un lenguaje accesible para diversas audiencias, incluidos quienes toman decisiones y el público en general;
Redactar, editar o brindar asesoría sobre comunicados de prensa, artículos de opinión, contenido web, contenido para redes sociales y otros materiales de comunicación; 
Establecer y mantener relaciones con periodistas, influencers digitales y otros contactos de los medios de comunicación en México y, según corresponda, en otros mercados mediáticos de América Latina;
Dar seguimiento a la cobertura mediática relevante, las narrativas públicas y las tendencias de comunicación en México y América Latina, y ofrecer recomendaciones periódicas para mejorar los mensajes;
Participar en reuniones virtuales con el personal del Programa Internacional y mantener una comunicación frecuente para informar al Programa sobre el avance del trabajo; y
Participar con frecuencia en reuniones presenciales con organizaciones aliadas en México y realizar varios viajes al año a Estados Unidos y a otros países para reunirse con Earthjustice y con otras organizaciones aliadas internacionales (los gastos de viaje relacionados con estas actividades serán reembolsados).
El trabajo se llevará a cabo tanto en español como en inglés.


Requisitos:


Al menos cinco años de experiencia en comunicación, estrategia de medios, periodismo, relaciones públicas, incidencia digital o un campo relacionado, con experiencia significativa en México u otro mercado mediático latinoamericano.
Experiencia demostrada en el desarrollo y la implementación de estrategias de comunicación relacionadas con organizaciones sin fines de lucro, el interés público, el periodismo, el medio ambiente, los derechos humanos o la justicia social.
Capacidad demostrada para presentar propuestas de cobertura, preparar a personas voceras y conseguir cobertura mediática en México u otro mercado mediático latinoamericano.
Sólido conocimiento del panorama mediático en México, incluida la experiencia en el trabajo con periodistas y personas influyentes en los medios digitales; (se valorarán las relaciones existentes con periodistas o profesionales de la comunicación en México u otros mercados mediáticos latinoamericanos).
Dominio profesional oral y escrito del español y del inglés.
Capacidad para traducir cuestiones científicas y jurídicas complejas en comunicaciones convincentes y accesibles; (se valorará el conocimiento de temas como la protección del medio ambiente, los combustibles fósiles, la planificación energética, la calidad del aire, el clima, los derechos humanos o el derecho a un medio ambiente sano).
Buen criterio en contextos de incidencia políticamente sensibles o de alto impacto, incluida la capacidad de coordinar las comunicaciones prestando especial atención a las perspectivas de las comunidades afectadas.
Capacidad para establecer prioridades, gestionar múltiples plazos y responder con rapidez a nuevas oportunidades y acontecimientos.


Rango Salarial:

El rango salarial para este puesto es de MXN MXN 878,000 – 960,000 (approximately USD 45,500 – 56,000).

La compensación final será acorde con la experiencia y las cualificaciones de la persona seleccionada.

MODALIDAD DE CONTRATACIÓN: La persona seleccionada será contratada como empleada por medio de un Employer of Record (EOR), y no directamente por Earthjustice. Las prestaciones serán proporcionadas por el EOR y podrán diferir de las que se ofrecen a los empleados de Earthjustice.

Para Postularse

Las personas interesadas deberán enviar los siguientes documentos a través de Jobvite. Se dará prioridad a las solicitudes enviadas a más tardar el 30 de noviembre y las solicitudes recibidas después de dicha fecha podrán revisarse de manera continua hasta que se cubra el puesto. No se considerarán las solicitudes incompletas.
